title: The Front User Submit WordPress plugin before 5.1.0 does not validate the content of files uploaded through one of its…
description: The Front User Submit WordPress plugin versions before 5.1.0 contain a vulnerability where files uploaded through an unauthenticated endpoint are not properly validated. These files are served back with a Content-Type based on their content and an inline disposition, enabling attackers to upload HTML or SVG files that execute arbitrary JavaScript in the browsers of users who open them, including administrators.
